title: Crumb Project Bindings (.crumb.toml v1)
description: Parsed form of a project's `.crumb.toml`, which pins which account an agent working in this directory should use for each site. Looked up from the current directory upward; the nearest file wins. Contains no secrets and is meant to be committed.

accounts.description: Map of site key to account id, e.g. { "github": "github:work" }.
